attBesluta.text: I'm really diggin these forks, you can't beat them for the money. I have a 6 acre farm and bought these for my Kubota L2502. Right now, were building 3300 feet of perimeter wood fence and I'm using the forks to move concrete & lumber all over the place. I wouldn't hesitate to buy these.

This has been a game changer. It gives a sturdy table that takes a full 4 x 8 sheet of plywood. I use it to keep all my tools up off the ground so we aren't tripping over them or losing them. I can put my chop saw, table saw, and drill press on it at the same time. It also works great for my rail saw. It works great when I'm rebuilding electrical pumps or motors because I can lay everything out with plenty of room. When I'm done, it easily folds away.
pretty nice, it really does the work using it for several weeks as a drywall finisher / painter recommending it
